# VexFlow and embedded fonts

`vexflow.js` is the unchanged `build/cjs/vexflow-bravura.js` from the npm package **vexflow@5.2.0**.

- Source: https://github.com/vexflow/vexflow
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vexflow/v/5.2.0
- SHA-256: `c01738b89f8a9e3008ebee1f4bfe1846d165b6f01a398a8f179a5948c29b9536`
- Engraving library: MIT, see `VEXFLOW-LICENSE.txt` and `VEXFLOW-AUTHORS.md`.
- Embedded Bravura music font: SIL Open Font License, see `BRAVURA-LICENSE.txt`.
- Embedded Academico text font: SIL Open Font License, see `ACADEMICO-LICENSE.txt`.

Font data is embedded as local data URLs. The deployed app does not fetch this library or its fonts from a CDN. The source-map comment refers to an optional development map, which is not needed to run the app.
